name: saphira-desktop
description: Saphira — desktop companion with fully-local AI (brain, voice, ears)

scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run desktop:main
scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:build && node scripts/prune-platform.mjs linux && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb
scripts.desktop:package:win: npm run desktop:build && node scripts/prune-platform.mjs win && electron-builder --win nsis
